newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Hogar started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Consorcio Hogar started.

text.p: Daiwa Institute of Research America analyst David Fleming has started coverage of Mexican builder Consorcio Hogar SA de CV with a rating of buy.

-- In an Aug 8 report, Fleming said his rating was based on Hogar's "attractive valuation, its growth potential, its efficiency and its entrenched dominance of its very important local market, which we do not envision will change for at least the medium term."
-- The Guadalajara-based company "trades at a discount, in term of its price/earnings multiples to other publicly traded Mexican housing constructors," Fleming wrote.
-- "We believe Hogar has a stronger position in its own market than either of these better-known companies."
-- Fleming estimated 1997 and 1998 earnings per share at 0.87 peso and 1.24 pesos, respectively.
-- The company's shares were up 0.50 peso to 13.80 pesos in Mexico City.
